maddox.linePrev: With some smart-ass New York Jew
maddox.line: And the Jew laughed at Lester Maddox
maddox.lineNext: And the audience laughed at Lester Maddox too
stanza: Last night, I saw Lester Maddox on a TV show
With some smart-ass New York Jew
And the Jew laughed at Lester Maddox
And the audience laughed at Lester Maddox too
Well, he may be a fool, but he's our fool
If they think they're better than him, they're wrong
So I went to the park and I took some paper along
And that's where I made this song
